note: Rectangles [x, y, w, h] in viewport px, rounded to 0.01. Mock default context, on the list page of a connection, the toast gate off, the pointer at (1, 1), read 300 ms after the centre opened (after the menu opened, for scene menu) (no animation). A per-row part lists only the rows that have it (a row with no message has no rowText): align by facts.rows[i].hasMessage. The record times are seeded now ("now" label), the older one 26 h earlier (label "1d ago"; when 26 h ago is not yesterday, yesterday 12:00 is used and the label is "Nh ago" or "1d ago"): the time label width is time dependent. The muted note says "P1 is muted until 10:30 AM" (a fixed clock time tomorrow; the mock's own mute is for 1 hour from the click). The Dismiss button of a collapsed row has a box (24x24) and the actions container of its row has opacity 0 until the row is hovered or has focus within: the mock moves focus to the FIRST row when it opens the centre, so the actions of row 0 stand at opacity 1 and every other row at 0 (facts.rows[i].actionsOpacity, focusWithin; styles rowActions#0 and #1). Scene dots is not in the brief: four unread rows, one per severity. Styles are named `<part>` or `<part>#<index>`.
